content.short: Spruce is an identity tooling platform.
content.description: Spruce builds tools for decentralized identification, including credentialed wallets and cryptographic sign-ins for social media and other online accounts. Its focus is to give users control over their data by enabling a cryptographic identifier — for example, an Ethereum wallet address — to be used as a portable identity across multiple platforms. This approach helps individuals present and manage their identity on their own terms rather than being tied to any single service.

resources.title: What Is Selective Disclosure, and How Do Verifiable Credentials Reveal Only What's Needed?
resources.tldr: Showing a driving licence to prove your age hands over your address too. Selective disclosure turns that oversharing into proving exactly one fact and nothing more.

resources.title: What Is Device Binding, and How Does It Stop a Stolen Digital ID Being Reused?
resources.tldr: A digital credential that can be copied is worth very little. Device binding is the cryptographic layer that ties one to a single phone, and this explains how.

resources.title: Using a Mobile Driver's License at the Airport: How TSA mDL Acceptance Works
resources.tldr: Behind one tap at a checkpoint sits a chain of trust and a pile of interoperability standards. Traces that chain, which is the clearest worked example of digital ID in production.
